definitions: A mature plantain fruit that has turned yellow or black, indicating its sweetness and readiness for consumption, often cooked.
The edible fruit of a plantain plant when it has reached full ripeness, characterized by a soft texture and high sugar content.
examples: She fried the ripe plantain until it was golden brown.
The recipe called for two ripe plantains.
Ripe plantain is a staple in many Caribbean dishes.
